figurative_meaning_en: Sarcasm for an extremely ugly woman
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো একটা ডানাকাটা পরী, তার মুখ দেখলে সবাই হাসে।
পার্টিতে এসে ডানাকাটা পরীর মতো সাজতে গিয়ে আরও খারাপ লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She looks like a wing-clipped fairy; everyone laughs at her face.
Trying to dress up for the party made her look even more like an extremely ugly woman.
history: Derived from Bengali folklore where 'pari' (fairies) are depicted as beautiful winged beings; clipping wings symbolizes loss of beauty or grace.
note: This idiom draws on mythical imagery to convey mockery.
